FX-RECOLOR-001.says: The line chosen, new colour #ff0000: the box's line and its half-covering edge turn red, the edge still half covering; the skin and the trace line are untouched.

FX-RECOLOR-002.says: No colour chosen: the drawing, untouched.

FX-RECOLOR-003.says: The line chosen one step off in blue, tolerance 0: nothing is chosen, and the drawing is untouched.

FX-RECOLOR-004.says: The same at tolerance 1: the line is chosen again, and this is FX-RECOLOR-001.

FX-RECOLOR-005.says: The line and the trace line chosen, new colour #3060ff: both turn blue.

FX-RECOLOR-006.says: FX-RECOLOR-001 with both colours written in capitals: the same.

FX-RECOLOR-007.says: #28242e chosen, 10 above the line on every channel, tolerance keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 4, linear: frames 0 and 1, at 0 and 5, choose nothing; frame 2, at exactly 10, is FX-RECOLOR-001, and so is frame 4.

FX-RECOLOR-008.says: FX-RECOLOR-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-RECOLOR-009.says: The new colour is the line's own: the drawing, untouched.

FX-RECOLOR-010.says: The new colour is the skin's: the line turns to skin and vanishes into it, and its edge is skin at half covering.

FX-RECOLOR-011.says: Tolerance 255: every pixel that shows is chosen and turns red; the empty ones stay empty.

FX-RECOLOR-012.says: Tolerance 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RECOLOR-013.says: Tolerance -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RECOLOR-014.says: Tolerance keyed to 300 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RECOLOR-015.says: Nine colours, one more than eight. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RECOLOR-016.says: A colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RECOLOR-017.says: A new colour written "red". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RECOLOR-018.says: A new colour left empty, which this effect does not allow. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
